vtable.extent_evidence: PROVEN BY THE FOLLOWING WORD, not inferred. Read from extracted/overlays/overlay_0025.bin at base 0x021111a0 (the `.text start:` on line 1 of config/arm9/overlays/ov025/delinks.txt): 32 consecutive function pointers run from the address point 0x02113760 through 0x021137dc. The next word, at 0x021137e0, is 0x44616437 -- little-endian bytes 37 64 61 44, the ASCII "7daD" that begins the following _ZTS type-name string, not a code pointer. So 0x021137e0 is the exclusive end and the emitted preamble-plus-slots storage is exactly 0x88 bytes. tubuild verify independently reports the emitted _ZTV section at size 0x88, which corroborates 32 slots (0x88 = 2 preamble words + 32). tools/rtti_vtables.py would report 34 for this class; that is the known _ZTV extent overrun counting the two preamble words as slots.
vtable.slot_name_note: Names are inherited interface labels from include/dActor_c.h and include/dBgActor_c.h, or ABI destructor labels. The ROM proves slot identity and target address; it does not preserve those English spellings.
vtable.inherited_slots_note: MEASURED by word-diffing this table against _ZTV10dBgActor_c (ov002 0x0210ae38, base 0x020ad660) slot for slot: exactly six words differ, slots 0, 3, 6, 9, 16 and 17, and every other word is byte-identical to dBgActor_c's. So this class overrides nothing else and adds no new virtual of its own. Slot 31 is 0x020ee55c, dBgActor_c's own Kill, inherited rather than overridden -- and slot 31 existing at all is what makes the table 32 words rather than dActor_c's 31: the dBgActor_c length rule.
vtable.destructor_order: D1 at 0x021111a0 precedes D0 at 0x021111e4 in the cartridge, and no D2 exists anywhere in the module. D1-BELOW-D0 IS THE REPRODUCIBLE DIRECTION: it is exactly what mwccarm 2004/b56 emits from an INLINE in-class virtual destructor, so no subset licensing is needed and this TU promotes whole. The out-of-line form would give D2, D0, D1 plus a homeless D2 and would fail linkcheck's ROM-ascending .text audit. include/daDgr_c.h previously declared the destructor out of line by analogy with include/BigBrickBlock.h; that analogy is wrong for this class and the promotion corrected it.

size.evidence: The class factory (daDgr_c_classInit, historical alias func_ov025_02111898) passes the literal 820 = 0x334 to fBase_c::operator new, read off the retail instruction. A field span is only a lower bound; this literal is the size. It closes exactly on dBgActor_c's 0x320 plus this class's own 0x14 tail bytes.

layout.inherited_through: dBgActor_c, which ends its own data at 0x31e and rounds to 0x320

own_fields.name: mBasePosY
own_fields.evidence: InitResources copies dActor_c::mPosY (+0x60) here; Behavior reads it back as the resting height that the sine offset from data_02082214 is added to, and as the base for the dust particles' Y.

own_fields.name: mAngleXSpeed
own_fields.evidence: Behavior sets it to +-(0x400/n) and accumulates it into dActor_c::mAngleX every frame of a swing; InitResources zeroes it.

own_fields.name: mPhaseTimer
own_fields.evidence: Behavior increments it on every call and compares it against 0x20, against n+8 and against m = n<<3. Read unsigned.

own_fields.name: mSwingStage
own_fields.evidence: Incremented up to 0x14 then reset to the -1 sentinel; read as `10 - value` to shape the swing speed. Signed: the -1 compare is a signed test.

own_fields.name: mSwingDir
own_fields.evidence: Toggled with XOR 1 at the end of a swing; picks the sign of mAngleXSpeed and of the Z step.

own_fields.name: pad_32a
own_fields.evidence: Never dereferenced by any of the nine functions; 2 bytes closing the s8/u8 pair up to the next s32.

own_fields.name: mDustParticle1
own_fields.evidence: A Particle::System::New handle (effect 0x2d) passed back as that call's own first argument, i.e. handle recycling; positioned 100 units along the platform's facing.

own_fields.name: mDustParticle2
own_fields.evidence: The same handle shape for the other end, 100 units the opposite way. 0x330 + 4 = 0x334, the factory's allocation literal.

unproven: func_ov025_0211123c, func_ov025_021112e0 and func_ov025_02111344 have no ROM-preserved names. config/arm9/overlays/ov025/symbols.txt spells all three by address and include/decl_common.h types them as taking char*, so the promotion keeps those spellings and leaves them extern "C" free functions rather than inventing member names. Their bodies, signatures as used, and call sites are proven; their original identifiers, member-versus-free form, and parameter types are not.

The header's field names (mBasePosY, mAngleXSpeed, mPhaseTimer, mSwingStage, mSwingDir, mDustParticle1, mDustParticle2) are descriptive reconstructions predating this promotion. Offsets, widths, signedness and the arithmetic relating them are ROM-proven; the English spellings are not.

The `swinging platform` reading of Behavior -- easing via `10 - mSwingStage` bucketed to 1/2/4, dust at either end, a ground shake on the last frame -- is an interpretation of proven arithmetic, not a ROM fact.
